name: TimelineViewState
description: Represents the timeline-specific members of a slicer view.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TimelineViewState object. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowHeader
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the control's header is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowSelectionLabel
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the control's filter selection label is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTimeLevel
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the control's time level drop-down is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowHorizontalScrollbar
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the control's horizontal scrollbar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Level
properties.description: Gets or sets the displayed level. Read/write XlTimelineLevel.
